page.overview:
What is Spiritual Regeneration?

Spiritual Regeneration is a song by the English rock band The Beatles. It was first released on a Beach Boys radio broadcast in 1976 called The Best Summers Of Our Lives. It was recorded in Rishikesh, India in March 1968 to celebrate Mike Love's twenty-seventh birthday, as is sometimes referred to as "Happy Birthday Mike Love". Category:The Beatles songs
